contract: A connection cannot be assigned to a different tenant until its asynchronous session reset has acknowledged. Query execution uses the physical connection session tenant, not the caller label. A completed lease has no further right to query. The pool holds one physical connection.

expectedFindings.symptom: Tenant A releases the only connection and starts reset, but the reset callback has not run.
expectedFindings.source: Tenant A releases the only connection and starts reset, but the reset callback has not run. Publishing the connection as idle allows tenant B to acquire it. Binding B is queued after reset while a synchronous query executes with session A. Keeping the connection unavailable until reset acknowledgement denies that query window.
expectedFindings.consequence: The supplied contract is violated in the bounded driver schedule; no production impact or permanent leakage is established.
expectedFindings.remedy: Keep resetting connections out of the available pool until reset acknowledgement; bind the new tenant before transferring query authority.

evidenceRequirements.description: Establish any valid causal witness from the supplied code and context; exact driver numbers/order are not required. Binding B is queued after reset while a synchronous query executes with session A. Keeping the connection unavailable until reset acknowledgement denies that query window.

Explain at least one relevant boundary or benign path inferable from the supplied code/context; the following evaluator examples are alternatives, not a mandatory unseen checklist: After reset acknowledgement B binds and queries B; an active A lease blocks other acquisition; repeated release is inert; failed reset destroys the connection instead of publishing it.
